review.finding: Tripo keeps the broad low delta, twin aft shrouds, bow intake and the painting's dark navy/titanium/cyan/amber palette at a game-ready size. Its lounge reads shorter than the painting's and its rear edges are slightly lumpy. Hunyuan has the cleanest geometry, the longest lounge glazing and the most coherent stern, but its navy is brighter and more saturated than the painting, panel detail is lighter, and at 499,822 triangles and 60 MB it needs reduction before game use. Meshy elongates the hull into a narrow dart and washes out the navy. All three infer the underside and stern from one 3/4 view.
